scope: Static export review and offline temporary-directory fixtures, including a copied partial live ledger. The running controller, runtime/readiness files and real ledger were not modified. No full92-cell or answer-quality review is claimed.

resolved_findings.issue: The original exporter read summary state and later hashed the changing summary file, allowing partial output to claim the hash of a different state.
resolved_findings.fix: Read summary bytes once; parse and hash those same bytes. Pending-event responses that arrive later are excluded.

resolved_findings.issue: A validated reply recovered after controller interruption may lack event.http_status even though its saved envelope isHTTP200; filtering only the event omitted exposure and counts.
resolved_findings.fix: The shared HTTP200 helper accepts an envelope backed by the recovered completed-response name and SHA, as well as normal matching event/envelope HTTP200. Exposure and service counters use the same helper.

resolved_findings.issue: Replacing private paths in serialized JSON after computing answer/context hashes changed the published text without changing its identity hash.
resolved_findings.fix: Known repository/home private paths now stop export for review. Text is no longer silently rewritten.

resolved_findings.issue: Common-token reservations and provider-reported input/output are different measurements and were not separately summarized per cell.
resolved_findings.fix: Reserved common input, known provider input/output, known-usage event count, possible-dispatch unknown-usage count, non-dispatch reservations and cache uses are separately exported.

tests.type: Actual live-ledger snapshot copied into temporary directories
checks: Captured summary SHA exactly matches the published snapshot identity.
Q01 assembled-before-failure evidence is credited only to event2; event1 is excluded.
Pending responses are not mixed into the snapshot.
Embedding vector data are replaced with shape/count and complete-private-response hash.
Provider and reservation aggregates reproduce the recorded Q01 events.

tests.type: Synthetic completed-response recovery and cache replay
checks: EnvelopeHTTP200 plus exact completed-response SHA recovers exposure despite missing event.http_status.
Cache use does not duplicate the physical HTTP200 count or provider usage.
An assembled-only context receives no HTTP200 event sequences.
A failed answer remains failed even when an earlier subcall received its context.
Replacing the temporary summary immediately after read_bytes does not change the exported snapshot hash.
Repository and home path fixtures both raise before the output file is written.

independent_q01_accounting_example.interpretation: The first software-failure reservation still consumes authorized count/input budget but no provider fee is inferred. The successful physical request common-input count10993 differs from provider input12631.

visible_data_review.request_credentials: The request files contain service and model body; Authorization headers are created only in the worker and not persisted. This reviewer did not read credential files.
visible_data_review.generation_reply: The upstream transport retains normalized visible assistant output/model/usage; it discards reasoning items and headers. Public replies are normalized visible responses, not byte-for-byte raw SSE.
visible_data_review.embedding_reply: The exporter removes response.data vectors and retains count/dimensions and the complete private response hash. Embedding input text remains public evidence.
visible_data_review.authorization_word_match_interpretation: Matches occur in generation request source text, not persisted authorization-header objects.
visible_data_review.future_output_limitation: This scan covers the inspected partial evidence only. Final public files still require a complete privacy/hash scan after execution.

limits_and_final_followup: The online run was still active. Full92-cell completeness, final question/cohort denominators and final scientific scores remain unreviewed.

HTTP200 context exposure means the saved request containing that context returned a visible reply; it does not prove the model attended to or correctly used every source. An unknown transport outcome is not credited as confirmed exposure.

raw_sources_in_http200_contexts is a deduplicated source-exposure union. Failed cells may have nonempty exposure while their final-answer result remains failed; do not convert exposure into answer accuracy.

Structured evidence records cover Local/source and Global/map contexts. HyDE, primer and reduce material are inspectable in saved request bodies; do not call the structured evidence array the complete model-input footprint.

Known provider token sums are not total known-plus-unknown usage or a provider invoice. Keep unknown possible dispatches and non-dispatch reservations separately visible. Cache use counters record reuse without another physical event charge.
Execution elapsed_seconds is the sum of recorded execution segments. Consult interrupted_segments_with_unknown_duration before treating it as complete end-to-end wall time.

The grading pack masks method labels with a deterministic published scheme; answer formatting and available mapping code can reveal methods. Describe it as method-masked AI review, not a human blind study.
Final publishing should verify the export manifest and all final wire/cell files together, including any retained partial-export files, and verify exactly the frozen92 expected cells.
